verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents per-release dashboard filtering that shows which release introduced errors, timeline release annotations correlated with error rates, views of newly introduced errors, and stability tracking against targets. Community users also praise the dashboard. However, the evidence is scoped to individual projects, with nothing showing aggregation across projects or teams or a dedicated regressions view. Missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregate dashboards, explicit top-regressions reporting, independent hands-on corroboration of trend analytics.
